message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time, UTC‑5 otherwise).  
If you know the current UTC time, just subtract 4 hours (or 5 hours in winter) to get the local time in NYC.  

For the most accurate answer, check your phone, computer, or a reliable online time‑zone converter.
